abstract.t: The Agentic Session Initiation Protocol (A-SIP) is used for the establishment and lifecycle maintenance of agentic dialogs. It also enables and content exchange between a principal and an AI Agent over the Internet. A-SIP can be used between a user agent and AI Agent, between AI Agents, or between an AI Agent and a tool with agentic- like properties. A-SIP is built ontop of HTTP/3, web transport and Media Over Quic Transport (MOQT), leveraging a modern, public-cloud friendly protocol stack. Its usage of MOQT is optional, needed only when real-time media is exchanged. This allows asynchronous agent interactions to be done entirely using HTTP/3, so simple cases remain simple. Despite the name, A-SIP has no technical relationship with SIP (RFC3261). This document is not yet a fully fleshed out protocol, and is meant to solicit feedback on this general direction of work.
